hebrewText: וְ/הַ/בַּ֛יִת אֲשֶׁר אֲנִ֥י בוֹנֶ֖ה גָּד֑וֹל כִּֽי גָד֥וֹל אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ מִ/כָּל הָ/אֱלֹהִֽים

As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.

(begin to) build(-er), obtain children, make, repair, set (up), [idiom] surely.
